goal: Generate a step-by-step diagram for tomato scrambled eggs, suitable for WeChat, Xiaohongshu, or family recipe book pages.

ingredients.design: Each item has a mini icon on the left: tomato circle, egg, scallion, salt shaker, oil drop

steps.count: Saturated and glaring background colors impact text recognition.

items.scene: Tomatoes cut into wedges, eggs beaten with a pinch of salt until small bubbles form.
In the frying pan, heat oil until it slightly smokes, pour in the egg mixture, use chopsticks to stir until half coagulated, then serve out
add a little oil, stir-fry tomatoes over high heat until they start to caramelize at the edges
Beat the eggs back, add salt, a little sugar, and quickly mix for 10 seconds
Turn off the fire, sprinkle with green onions, plate and drizzle with a bit of pot juice

steps.step_block_style: Circular Number + Side Profile Illustration + A Brief Description

style.art_style: Hand-painted watercolor + light beige watercolor paper texture + fine pencil line draft feel
style.color_palette: Tomato red, egg yolk, green onion, rice white.

must_keep: Each step description does not exceed 15 characters
Ingredient list corresponds with step actions
The finished product area is slightly oversaturated, appealing to appetite.
avoid: A bizarre device unrelated to Chinese food appears in a single step
Fluorescent blue and other food-related colors are the main colors covering large areas
